verdict.rationale: Datadog Monitors (docs-10) support alerting on any metric, log, trace, or APM signal, with notification routing to teams/channels, alert grouping, and mute/silence capabilities documented as core features; SLOs (docs-11), Watchdog (docs-16) and Incident Management (docs-14) further support alerting workflows. missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of grouping/silencing UX specifics, and community feedback focuses on cost/UI rather than confirming alerting mechanics.
